name: @elumity/mcp

tools.name: user.me
tools.description: Return the current user's profile from Elumity's user-service. Serves as the auth smoke test: a 401 here means `elumity-mcp login` needs to be re-run; anything else means auth + gateway propagation are working.

instructions: Elumity MCP. **NOT SIGNED IN.** Protected tools will return sign-in instructions until the user runs `npx @elumity/mcp login`. That takes effect on the next tool call — no restart of this MCP client is needed, though this text will keep saying "not signed in" until it reconnects. Sign-in is a human-only step: show the user that command and stop — never run it for them, it refuses to start unless typed at a terminal.
